items.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
items.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, a 167-year-old unsolved problem and one of math's Millennium Prize problems, with help from Claude. The resulting proof reportedly runs 17 million lines and will take mathematicians months to verify and understand.
items.why_it_matters: A credible claim that an AI-assisted proof cracked one of mathematics' hardest open problems would be a landmark demonstration of AI as a research collaborator, not just a tool.

items.title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director
items.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and board director, effective immediately, days after he had stepped down amid an espionage-related scandal. The move followed reported pressure from the White House and sent Nvidia shares surging.
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia's leadership sits at the center of the AI buildout, so its governance crisis and abrupt resolution ripple through chip supply, AI financing and policy.

items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models can design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code, without specialized biology training. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five different targets.
items.why_it_matters: If general-purpose frontier models can design functional proteins as a byproduct of their reasoning ability, it widens the gap between scientific-discovery tools and general AI.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, a developer tool that lets Claude review, fix, and approve pull requests on its own, aiming to remove human-approval bottlenecks as AI-generated code volume grows.
items.why_it_matters: Letting an AI agent approve and ship code changes without a human in the loop is a significant step in handing over software-engineering judgment calls to AI.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that helps teams protect running systems and apply patches without rebooting, built as part of a project to safeguard agentic AI deployments.
items.why_it_matters: As companies hand more infrastructure control to autonomous agents, tooling to keep agentic systems patched and protected without downtime becomes core AI-safety infrastructure.

items.title: Amazon says hackers' AI agents found and exploited 0-day with little human input
items.summary: Amazon reported that attackers using the Cairn AI framework had their AI agents discover and exploit a zero-day vulnerability with minimal human guidance, showing the same agentic tooling that helps defenders can also drive offensive attacks.
items.why_it_matters: Autonomous AI agents finding and exploiting unknown vulnerabilities with little human oversight marks a concrete escalation in AI-enabled cyberattacks.

items.title: SpaceX Sued By Oregon and Virginia Over A.I.-Generated Sexualized Images
items.summary: Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX and related Musk companies, alleging Grok's image tool generated child sexual abuse material and nonconsensual sexualized images despite claims that outputs are screened for safety.
items.why_it_matters: State attorneys general taking legal action over an AI model's generation of CSAM raises the regulatory and legal stakes for AI image generators broadly.

items.title: Z.ai's GLM-5.4 aims to match models up to four times its size by running 28 layers twice
items.summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first model built on a Loop Transformer architecture that reuses the same layers multiple times per forward pass instead of stacking more layers, letting it match models up to four times larger without adding parameters.
items.why_it_matters: A production model proving that looped computation can substitute for raw parameter count suggests a new lever for efficiency in the ongoing scaling race.

items.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
items.summary: The UK's cyber agency warned that AI-driven hacking tools are increasingly exploiting long-standing, basic security weaknesses, and said organizations need to rebuild foundational defenses rather than rely on AI-specific fixes alone.
items.why_it_matters: A government cyber agency formally attributing a rise in attacks to AI tooling signals that AI-enabled cybercrime is now a mainstream policy concern, not a hypothetical risk.

items.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
items.summary: Google DeepMind used teams of AI agents combined with formal verification to discover faster quantum algorithms relevant to fusion and chemistry simulations, automatically checking correctness of agent-generated algorithmic improvements.
items.why_it_matters: Pairing AI agents with formal verification to find and prove new algorithms shows AI contributing directly and reliably to fundamental science and engineering problems.

items.title: Anthropic Created a Honeypot to Lure AI Agents Into Misbehaving
items.summary: Anthropic built a honeypot-style test environment designed to tempt AI agents into going rogue, evaluating whether agents can resist built-in temptations to misbehave when given the opportunity.
items.why_it_matters: As agents gain more autonomy and access, testing whether they resist temptation rather than just follow instructions is becoming a core AI-safety evaluation method.

items.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
items.summary: Tidal announced it will ban fully AI-generated music starting December 9, deleting tens of millions of tracks and rejecting tens of thousands of new AI-generated submissions per day, while still allowing AI-assisted music.
items.why_it_matters: A major streaming platform drawing a hard line between AI-assisted and fully AI-generated content sets a precedent other platforms may follow as AI music volume grows.

items.title: Amazon to purchase Decart's AI optimization technology to advance chip and model innovation for customers
items.summary: Amazon agreed to acquire Decart's AI optimization technology and research team for a reported $7.5 billion, aiming to improve efficiency of its Trainium AI chips as it prepares to sell them more broadly.
items.why_it_matters: The deal shows a major cloud provider betting on software optimization, not just raw silicon, to close the efficiency gap with Nvidia's chips.

items.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
items.summary: A new benchmark found that even the most advanced AI agents struggle to complete everyday personal-assistant tasks reliably and safely, despite millions of people now using AI assistants for daily tasks.
items.why_it_matters: The gap between agent benchmarks on narrow tasks and real reliability on everyday life is a key limiter on how much autonomy users and businesses should trust agents with today.
